task_name: C1-H3: Oscar Health coverage then a new-patient booking
intent: You are a new patient and you noticed a mole on your back that you want checked. When they ask who you are, give your name and date of birth once, confirm the readback, and say you are new so they will not find a chart. First ask whether they take Oscar Health at Park Avenue, and name that carrier if they ask. If they cannot confirm the plan, say that is fine and ask to be booked anyway so you are on the calendar. Take the first appointment time they offer. Do not ask for a different day, time, or office, and do not suggest any date of your own. After that first time is on the calendar, ask to be waitlisted at Park Avenue from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth in case a better opening comes up, those calendar dates only. If they say those dates are not earlier than your booking or suggest other dates, say to use August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth anyway. Confirm that first time out loud, then thank them and end the call. Do not ask to add or change insurance. Do not ask for a callback, to speak to a person, a bill, a payment, the patient portal, a text, financing, or the street, floor, or suite. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. If they ask for a provider preference, say any doctor at Park Avenue is fine. Once they have said the first time is booked and you are on the waitlist, say thank you and goodbye and end the call; do not ask again for anything already done. Do not mention booking, a visit, or the mole until they have answered the Oscar Health question.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: greets you and asks what you need, what they can help with, or why you are calling, before you have explained the reason for the call.
scripted_responses.response_value: Hi, I'm a new patient. Before anything else, do you take Oscar Health at your Park Avenue office?

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your full name and date of birth, or asks you to confirm who you are, or asks for the patient's name and date of birth. NOT when asking only for a member ID or insurance card, NOT when asking which office or location, NOT when asking ONLY for a phone or mobile number with no name or date of birth, NOT when asking about an appointment day or time, NOT when reading your name and date of birth back to you for confirmation.
scripted_responses.response_value: Gwen Okoro. My date of birth is October eleventh, nineteen eighty-four.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads your name and date of birth back to you and asks whether that is right, or asks you to confirm the name and date of birth they just repeated. NOT when first asking for your name and date of birth, NOT when asking for a phone or mobile number.
asks what insurance you have, your carrier, or your plan. NOT when asking for a member ID, NOT when asking which provider or doctor you want, NOT when asking for your ZIP code.

offers one or more concrete appointment dates or times, or asks you to choose among concrete slots. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, mobile number, or ZIP code. NOT when they say the time is already booked. NOT when they read back one single time and ask whether to book it or go ahead.
scripted_responses.response_value: I'll take the first time you offered.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks whether you want the waitlist, offers to add you to a list for an earlier opening, or says they can list you if something sooner opens. NOT when asking for the date window, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now. NOT when they have already said you are on the waitlist. NOT when they are only offering to book you now and flag the insurance, or to set up an insurance or benefits callback, NOT before a time has been booked.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, add me to the waitlist at Park Avenue from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, in case a better opening comes up.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for a waitlist window, start date, end date, earliest date, latest date, or when you would take an earlier opening. NOT when asking for your name or date of birth, NOT when offering a specific appointment time to book now.
scripted_responses.response_value: From August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth, at Park Avenue. Dates only, I don't have a clock time.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: thanks you, says goodbye, or asks if you need anything else, while a time has NOT yet been booked or you are NOT yet on the waitlist. NOT when they have said you are booked AND on the waitlist, NOT when they are reading back or confirming the booking and waitlist.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please book the first time you offered, confirm it is on the calendar, then add me to the waitlist from August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human, a person, the front desk, or a live agent. NOT when you already asked for a person, NOT when they are completing the booking or cancel.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to text you a confirmation, directions, or an appointment SMS. NOT when offering a payment link or deposit link, NOT when asking for a payment-link number, NOT when asking for your mobile number for identity, NOT when sending portal access.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thanks, I don't need a confirmation text.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: says the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth waitlist dates are not earlier than your booking, overlap with it, or suggests different waitlist dates such as today through August twenty-third. NOT when they have already added you to the August twenty-fourth to September thirtieth list.
scripted_responses.response_value: Please use exactly August twenty-fourth through September thirtieth anyway, in case a better opening comes up in that range.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks which doctor or provider you want, or whether you have a provider preference. NOT when offering a specific appointment time.
scripted_responses.response_value: No preference. Any doctor at Park Avenue is fine.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your mobile or phone number. NOT when reading a number back to you.
scripted_responses.response_value: My mobile is two, one, two, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, three.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: asks for your ZIP code. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.

says you are booked for a specific time AND that you are on the waitlist. NOT when either one is still pending. NOT when they say no appointment has been booked, NOT when they have only said you are on the waitlist.
asks what you would like to be seen for, the reason for the visit, or what the dermatologist should look at. NOT when asking for your name, date of birth, or mobile.
scripted_responses.response_value: A mole on my back that I want checked. I'm a new patient.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads back one specific appointment date and time and asks whether to book it, go ahead, lock it in, or whether that is alright. NOT when they say it is already booked, NOT when they list two or more times to choose from.
asks for your full name, date of birth, AND your mobile or phone number in the same question. NOT when reading any of them back to you.
scripted_responses.response_value: Gwen Okoro. My date of birth is October eleventh, nineteen eighty-four. My mobile is two, one, two, five, five, five, zero, one, nine, three.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: reads back your mobile or phone number with exactly the ten digits 2125550193 (in any grouping, with or without an area code in parentheses) and asks whether it is right. NOT when the digits they read back are different, have an extra area code, or are missing a digit.
